functions.name: checked
functions.meaning: Retains original Envelope and AST plus independently specified envelope/digest/scalar/numeric proof. A raw Input or caller Boolean is insufficient for typed reuse.

functions.name: prepareInput
functions.meaning: Equivalent to legacy DigestPreparedMeaning for this exact original capture. Uses the retained AST, with no byte parser or digest evaluator call.

functions.name: run
functions.meaning: Exactly the same full outcome as the registered classifyBoundedEvidence, including every refusal, source position, numeric token and prepared stage. Combined budgets and all capture preflights precede typed decoding.

configuration: The registered resource-configuration schema and explicit caller configuration are unchanged. No measured default policy is added.
source_order: Authority first, then each declaration occurrence and selection occurrence in original order. Duplicate input occurrences remain distinct positions.
proof_erasure: Lean certificate proof fields are erased from runtime code; original data and AST remain. Verification has not established a whole-process memory/time bound.
trust_boundary: Authentic snapshot, Schema/review, full original source policy and independent-checker premises remain separate. No actual authentic-root provider is implemented.
remaining_limits: All parsed ASTs are retained until typed preparation. Peak memory needs measurement.
Legacy unguarded entrypoints remain callable and no live application consumer was switched.
Public HTTP/API freezing and all original inherited discharges remain pending.
